items.title: Pet HealthWorks introduces dual-action supplement
items.summary: The soft chew supplement supports weight control and joint health in canines.

items.title: TEMPTATIONS unveils new Halloween treat varieties

items.title: Oxyfresh brings dental water additive to PetSmart stores
